fields.why: Rates and joinpoint AQPCs are compared across 6 race/ethnicity groups, 5 age groups and county SES quartiles ('increases were largest among Black, followed by Hispanic'), which rule 4 makes groupwise.
County unemployment, education and uninsured quartiles are area SES measures; sex and urban/rural are 2 groups and disposition is not an SPD.
Group AQPCs and rates are only set side by side; the significance marks test each group's trend against zero (a non-SPD contrast within each level, rule 6), not differences across groups.
